reviewer: Root AI independent candidate source review, not a named teammate sign-off
basis: Actual 17 candidate files read and compared, before runtime acceptance

observations.description: All 12 Java candidates are new independent administrator order classes without storefront imports.
OrderQuery uses code-point trim/40 bound, fixed enums and positive nullable customer ID; negative integer pages normalize to 1.
OrderQuery offset() is a real record accessor and overflow is guarded before SQL list selection.
Customer filter projects only safe labels, accepts CUSTOMER regardless of status; missing or ADMIN returns 404.
List/count share exactly one WHERE fragment and fixed created_at/id descending order with bound values.
Detail reads order/item snapshots and safe customer labels; no mutable product join.
Ship public Service uses READ_COMMITTED and first calls the existing AdminWriteGuard.
Write path locks order without joins and performs no customer/item/product locks after actor guard.
Only PAID has conditional DML, checks one affected row and uses greatest UTC database now/paid_at.
SHIPPED/COMPLETED return before UPDATE and preserve full row including updated_at.
PENDING_PAYMENT/CANCELLED produce stable 409; malformed/unknown order paths 404.
Runtime write errors escape transaction proxy before controller renders conflict; no caught failure is reported successful.
303 RedirectView suppresses model attributes; flash feedback is fixed non-sensitive text.
A06 GET filters reset page and all pagination links preserve orderNo/status/userId/size.
A07 exposes ship form only for PAID, with CSRF and pre-submit order-number confirmation.
A07 uses escaped text and saved item/receiver/payment values; no unescaped HTML or extra state actions.
Administrator layout changes only one authenticated order link; original CSS prefix retained, new rules scoped A06/A07.
No existing user/admin Java, database scripts, dependencies or assets appear in candidate manifests.

limits: Static source and template reasoning only; build, SQL, HTTP and browser behavior must be separately executed.
